source: Pew Research Center. American Trends Panel Wave 70, fielded July 13-19, 2020.
method: Population is respondent's religious tradition (F_RELTRAD), restricted to respondents who attend religious services at least monthly (gated on XATTEND_W70). Share saying their house of worship should be restricting the number of people who can attend at one time in response to the coronavirus outbreak (vs. should not), CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70; refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own WEIGHT_W70 variable.
